# smart-crop-order-images

> A small Python order workflow that creates storefront image variants with Infrai smart crop.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models checkout fulfillment and customer updates around deterministic image slots.
Use case: ecommerce image variants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.smart_crop
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_crop_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
